{
  "findings": [
    {
      "title": "Overloaded Day 1 visits with multiple procedures",
      "quote": "Complete Physical Examination, Neurological Exam, and ECOG PS | X | X |  |  |  | X |  |  |  | X",
      "page": 56,
      "section": "Schedule of Activities",
      "category": "burden",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "Day 1 includes a complete physical exam, neurological exam, ECOG PS, ECG, vital signs, blood draws, and cemiplimab infusion, which is burdensome for patients and may require long clinic stays.",
      "fix": "Consider splitting the neurological exam to a separate visit or reducing assessments on Day 1."
    },
    {
      "title": "Tumor biopsies at multiple time points add burden",
      "quote": "Tumor biopsies for Group 218 | X |  | X |  |  |  |  |  |  |",
      "page": 56,
      "section": "Schedule of Activities",
      "category": "burden",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "Group 2 patients undergo tumor biopsies at screening and Day 22, which is invasive and may cause patient discomfort and dropout.",
      "fix": "Consider reducing to one biopsy or making the on-treatment biopsy optional."
    },
    {
      "title": "Frequent imaging may be excessive",
      "quote": "CT/MRI and/or digital photography | X |  | X |  |  |  | X | X |  |",
      "page": 56,
      "section": "Schedule of Activities",
      "category": "burden",
      "severity": "minor",
      "explanation": "Imaging is scheduled at screening, Day 22, Day 43, and Day 64, which may be more frequent than needed for tumor assessment and adds patient burden.",
      "fix": "Consider reducing imaging frequency to align with standard of care or response evaluation criteria."
    },
    {
      "title": "ADA sampling at multiple visits may be unnecessary",
      "quote": "ADA |  | X |  | X |  | X |  |  |  | X",
      "page": 56,
      "section": "Schedule of Activities",
      "category": "burden",
      "severity": "minor",
      "explanation": "ADA is collected at Day 1, Day 43, Cycle 2 Day 1, and End of Study, which may be more than needed for immunogenicity assessment.",
      "fix": "Consider reducing ADA sampling to key timepoints (e.g., Day 1, Day 43, and End of Study)."
    },
    {
      "title": "Tight windows for Day 22 and Day 43 visits",
      "quote": "22± 3 (Day 22) | 43± 3 (Day 43) | 64±3 (Day 64)",
      "page": 56,
      "section": "Schedule of Activities",
      "category": "consistency",
      "severity": "minor",
      "explanation": "The ±3 day windows for Day 22, 43, and 64 may be difficult for patients to meet, especially if they have travel or work constraints.",
      "fix": "Consider widening windows to ±5 days or allowing flexibility for holidays and weekends."
    },
    {
      "title": "Serum HCG must be ≤72 hours before first dose",
      "quote": "Serum HCG ≤72 Hour Predose | X |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |",
      "page": 56,
      "section": "Schedule of Activities",
      "category": "advisory",
      "severity": "minor",
      "explanation": "The 72-hour requirement for serum HCG may be logistically challenging if the first dose is delayed or rescheduled.",
      "fix": "Consider allowing a urine pregnancy test within 72 hours or extending the window to 7 days."
    },
    {
      "title": "End of Study visit includes many procedures",
      "quote": "End of Study 30 days after last dose cemiplimab 3",
      "page": 56,
      "section": "Schedule of Activities",
      "category": "burden",
      "severity": "minor",
      "explanation": "The End of Study visit includes physical exam, ECG, vital signs, blood draws, and pregnancy test, which may be burdensome for patients who have completed treatment.",
      "fix": "Consider reducing the number of procedures at End of Study or allowing remote visits for some assessments."
    },
    {
      "title": "Missing PK sampling at later cycles",
      "quote": "Cemiplimab PK/Drug Conc |  | X | X | X |  | X |  |  |  | X",
      "page": 56,
      "section": "Schedule of Activities",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "PK sampling is only done through Day 64 and then at End of Study, missing steady-state concentrations during later cycles, which may limit PK analysis.",
      "fix": "Add PK sampling at a later cycle (e.g., Cycle 4 or 6) to capture steady-state exposure."
    }
  ]
}
